senses.gloss: f. (v. כֶּרֶם) a marked off plot in a public thoroughfare, in gen. an area which cannot be classified either as private ground (רשות היחיד) or as public ground (רשות הרבים).
units: Y. Sabb. XI, 13ᵃ כל המעכב … נקרא כ׳ whatever obstructs the public road is called karm’lith.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:1">Tosef. ib. I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 6a:9">Sabb. 6ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T01079"><he>רָשׁוּת</he></cite>.
Ib. אבל … ואיסטוונית והכ׳ but the sea, the valley, the colonnade and the carm’lith; expl.
<cite ref="Shabbat 7a:3">ib. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>קרן זוית הסמוכה לרה״ר</he> a corner plot adjoining the public road; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּרְמְלִיּוֹת</he>. Y. ib. XI, end, 13ᵇ
